title: Wayo-wa / Вэйо-ва
rejectionReason: User wants stronger, faster rhythmic accents, a viral family-oriented TikTok listening reference, and rhyming combinations of the three characters' syllables.
prompt:
Create one complete original uplifting dance-pop song for a family rhythm game, titled "Wayo-wa". Approximately ninety seconds with a proper ending, not a demo, teaser or short loop. Sunny adventurous autumn mood, catchy enough for children and teenagers, energetic and polished rather than babyish. New original melody and arrangement.

Steady clear 128 BPM, 4/4. Strong clean kick on the beat, crisp handclaps/snare, buoyant warm bass, wooden/marimba-like plucks, sparkling airy whistle-synth hook and light acoustic accents. Keep the beat and vocal attacks easy to hear for a rhythm platform game. Pleasant youthful human lead voice with warm clear diction, no squeaky cartoon timbre, no animal noises. Sing ONLY the invented syllables below, with English phonetic pronunciation: "Wayo-wa" = WAY-yo-wah, "pa-ri-pam" = pah-ree-pahm. No meaningful spoken lyrics, no narration.

A full compact song around 90 seconds: 4-bar instrumental pickup, 8-bar verse, 8-bar chorus, 4-bar instrumental break, 8-bar varied second verse, 12-bar final chorus, 4-bar satisfying outro; at128 BPM this is about90seconds. Begin promptly, avoid long ambient intros or extended fadeouts. Alternate short crisp syllables, clear small breathing gaps and occasional one-to-two-beat sustained vowels; let the instrumental groove continue beneath long vowels. Main hook recognizable on first hearing; dynamic lift in choruses.

Verse sung syllables:
Wayo-way, la-ru-va, pa-ri-pam
Wayo-wa, wa-ya-way, la-ru-lam
Pa-ri-pam, pa-ri-way, wayo-wa
Way-yo-oh, wa-ah, la-ru-way

Chorus:
Wayo-wa, wayo-wa — pa-ri-pam!
Wayo-way, wayo-wa — pa-ri-pam!
Way-eh-yo, wa-ah-ah — la-ru-way!
Pa-ri-pam, pa-ri-pam — wayo-way!

Repeat and vary these syllables melodically, keeping the chorus memorable, vocals front and center, rhythm accented and mix clean. Keep synth glides and long sustained background pads restrained so rhythmic accents stay distinct. No quotation or imitation of any existing song, artist, melody or recording. Deliver the full finished song in one generation.
